Chpater 1

The goblin army pierced through the border pass of Otto the Papal State and drove deep into its territory, leaving a trail of atrocities in their wake. Ultimately, they converged upon the theocracy's capital — Auroraburg.

Within the city, the surviving priestesses pooled their last vestiges of divine power to erect a faltering holy barrier, desperately defending this final bastion of hope.

Most of the nations surrounding the Otto Theocracy had already fallen to the goblin hordes. Now, those very goblins who professed conversion to the Holy Church have treacherously broken their oaths and launched a massive invasion into this last bastion of faith. Although the high walls of the capital, Aurora-Burg, still stand, it faces a more cruel internal trial: the already scarce food reserves must be prioritized for the cleric knights holding the walls, necessary to maintain the holy power needed to resist the enemy. Yet, at the same time, the countless refugees who have flooded into the city cannot be abandoned and must receive the bare minimum of sustenance to survive.

Each day, the bell signaling the food distribution strikes at the heart of everyone in the city.
Even the Pontiff herself must, in the lulls between battles, join the clergy in soothing the fears of the people.

Some refugees believed that since the goblins had also professed conversion to the Holy Church, the war was meaningless. Thus, on a night when all were exhausted, they chose to betray the Theocracy, sabotaging the sacred barrier from within. In the end, for the sake of the people remaining in the city, the Pontiff decided to surrender to the goblins.

It was her hope that, having chosen conversion, the goblins should not commit excessive atrocities against the clergy within the walls. The Pontiff was not naive in this; she was forced to cling to this one last, slim hope as the only choice left in a hopeless situation.

Chapter 2
After the city gates were opened, the female Pontiff entered into negotiations with the goblins' representatives. However, she was secretly detained during these talks and compelled to acquiesce to all of the goblins' demands: to transfer the religious authority to a new Pontiff appointed by the goblins, while she herself was forced to abdicate and perform a public act of penance.

After securing a promise from the goblins that they would neither massacre nor publicly humiliate the clergy, the Pontiff agreed to their terms. However, this was merely the prologue to the tragedy. With most of the Western Continent's nations already fallen, the victorious goblins had no reason left to honor any promises made to the conquered.

The female Pontiff was bound beneath a table, her feet protruding through the surface and locked into a foot stock. The goblins intended to tickle her soles, making her acutely aware of her position and forcing her complete submission to their will. Perhaps, not making her publicly endure this humiliation while being identified was the last vestige of the goblins' twisted mercy.

"The human body is such a delightful plaything! No matter how holy, noble, or powerful you once were, you all end up crumbling before mere tickling torture. Your helpless laughter and desperate struggles are the finest nourishment for our goblin spirits!

"Your laughter is particularly delightful, even among the multitude of our tickle slaves. If the mere soles of your feet can provide us with so much pleasure, I dare not imagine how utterly captivating you would be when subjected to the same... comprehensive tribulations as the others!"

An incessant stream of laughter from the female Pontiff beneath the table reached the goblins' ears, thrilling them beyond measure. They knew that this time, beyond seizing resources, wealth, and religious authority, they would also be gaining a new batch of premium tickle slaves.

Chapter 3
Three women, their heads hooded in black sacks, were bound fast to wooden frames. Though their faces were concealed, their voluptuous figures were left completely exposed and naked. The one in the center had snow-white skin, with glimpses of silver hair escaping her hood. The woman on the left also had pale skin and golden hair, while the one on the right sported a olive-toned complexion and dark, black hair.

A faint tremor ran through the bodies of all three women, born of the shame of their present nakedness. But for the two on either side, it was likely eclipsed by a more potent fear—the dread of what was to come

Soon, that familiar, unnerving sensation from their soles shot through their minds. It was a feeling they all knew too well, and one they had all learned to dread—especially those for whom it had been a prolonged and particular torment.

The tentacles crept relentlessly over their naked forms, gliding across the soft skin before zeroing in on their most ticklish spots—those secret zones of hypersensitivity that could not bear the slightest touch.

Unbridled laughter soon echoed through the once-hallowed church—a harrowing blend of the women's despairing and terrified shrieks of mirth, mingling with the goblins' hoarse, triumphant roars.
The branding iron in the brazier glowed red-hot. The tickling had ceased momentarily, leaving the woman gasping weakly. Then, an excruciating, searing pain shot through her pubis—the goblins had seared the mark of disgrace onto her very skin.

Upon her pubis, the word "HERETIC" had been branded, a mark that mirrored those upon the two women beside her.

After applying the salve and healing magic, the goblins wasted no time and resumed her tickle torture. Pain and itch now intertwined, a twin assault that ravaged both her body and her already frayed spirit simultaneously.

The once most authoritative religious leaders and spiritual faiths have now been branded as heretics, while the orthodox theocracy of the Western Continent has almost entirely fallen into the hands of the goblins.

Ch.4
As the Holy City settled into a new, oppressive “order” under the control of the goblins and their collaborators, the secret of the captured female Pontiff’s descent into being a “tickle slave” was secret no more among the goblin elite. A public humiliation ceremony, designed to shatter her dignity and divinity utterly, was now imminent, scheduled to take place within the very heart of what was once the city’s most sacred space.
Upon the platform at the center of the square, a woman with a soiled sack over her head was locked in a humiliating position within a pillory-like contraption reminiscent of a guillotine’s frame. Her body was forced to kneel upon a crude wooden box, and the ropes binding her legs were nailed directly into the planks of the box itself. This merciless design served a single, explicit purpose: to render even the slightest struggle utterly futile. She was presented—a meticulously secured offering—displaying the fate of all who dared rebel to the silent crowd below.

A heavy silence was broken only by the deliberate thud of boots on wood.

A towering goblin, unnaturally broad-shouldered, ascended the platform draped in the stark black robes of an executioner. He removed a leather glove, extending fingernails filed into glossy, dark points that caught the light for a sinister moment.

Kneeling behind the woman, he gripped one of her heels, pinning it down.

The razor edge of a nail made contact with the most tender arch of her foot—a touch so feather-light it was almost a caress.

Her body arched like a bowstring pulled taut. The wooden crate groaned; the ropes bit deeper into her flesh. From under the sack came a sound—first a choked gasp, then a shriek of laughter that tore at her throat. “St-stop… ah! AHAHA! NO!” It was neither prayer nor plea, but the raw, animal scream of a nerve pushed past its limit.

Her head thrashed wildly, the coarse fabric growing damp with tears and spittle. Her mind was a maelstrom of shame and visceral terror—this square, once a place of prayer, now a theater proving even her god had forsaken her. Yet, a shred of will fought against the rising tide of sensation, her body straining against its bonds in a futile, instinctual rebellion she knew was hopeless.
Yet this was only the overture.

Two more goblins in identical garb ascended the platform with a ritualistic gait. In silence, they pressed rough fingertips against her exposed skin and began their “work.” Knuckles scoured the delicate folds of her armpits with precision, then crept like insects over the frantic rise and fall of her ribs, finally descending upon the helplessly upturned curve of her buttocks. There, fingers employed a twisting, circular motion, tormenting every inch of sensitive flesh. This was no random tickling; it was a precision craft, honed by training to locate and detonate every nerve ending.

The woman’s struggles escalated from violent to frenzied. Muffled, choking sounds escaped the sack over her head. Her shoulder blades jerked like dying wings, and her waist twisted in a futile attempt to escape the inescapable touch. Yet, the yoke around her neck, the bonds at her wrists, and the cruel fixing of her calves to the box below transformed every surge of desperate strength into nothing but a futile tremor. All she could perceive was the traitorous, uncontrollable frenzy of her own body and the humiliation of sensation exploding from multiple points at once, merging into a boundless sea of itch. Her mind screamed, while her body convulsed in silent laughter—this was the most complete form of deprivation imaginable.
The dominion of torment continued to expand. Now, it was no longer just her soles, underarms, sides, or buttocks. Even her breasts—the most intimate and vulnerable—were invaded, becoming territory ravaged by those practiced fingers. As calloused knuckles and sharp nails scraped across skin that had never known such exposure, a piercing shame, sharper than any humiliation before, fused with the overwhelming tickling sensation and pierced her through.

A wave of frenzied excitement rippled through the goblin crowd below. Murky eyes glinted with avaricious arousal.

“Look! Look how she shudders!” a scrawny goblin squealed, standing on tiptoe to point a bony finger at the form writhing on the platform, convulsing with uncontrollable sensation.

“Hahaha! We haven’t even started on the soles proper, just a few scratches!” another bellowed, waving a filthy cap, spittle flying. “A ‘reaction’ this good… she’ll breed the finest ‘laughter-stock’!”

Excited whispers spread like blight through the throng. Goblins jostled and shoved, eager to press closer, to drink in every detail of her agonized twitches, every choked whimper that escaped the sack over her head. To them, this was no mere punishment; it was a public audition, an appraisal of a potential acquisition’s quality.

An older goblin with a wispy, tangled beard squinted his shrewd eyes, leaning to rasp to his companion: “We’ve got plenty of ‘stock’ in the pens, aye… but a ‘prime piece’ like this, one that sings so sharply at just a touch… that’s rare.” He grinned, yellowed teeth bared, every crevice of his face etched with cruel delight. “See the life in that struggle? So vivid! Once she’s properly… broken in, kept in one of the ‘giggle-cages’… why, just watching her shiver with her own terrified thoughts could amuse us for half a day.”

His companion grunted in agreement, gaze glued to the spectacle. “Aye. Some in the warehouses are getting a bit… dull. This one’s fresh. The trainers will have their work cut out, unlocking all that potential.” He stressed the word “unlocking,” prompting a round of knowing, gravelly chuckles from those around them.

The ongoing struggle on the platform and the casual, brutal critique from below wove together into a grotesque tapestry. The goblins didn’t merely desire another slave; they reveled in the act of acquisition itself, and in the certainty that yet another once-lofty being was being meticulously crushed, remolded, and ultimately cataloged into their vast and darkened collection—a living “treasure” to be enjoyed again and again. The woman’s fear and sensitivity weren’t flaws to pity; they were the most exquisite seasoning, making this cruel entertainment all the more savory.
She didn’t know how long it had been—a quarter of an hour, perhaps an eternity—but the mind-breaking tickle torture finally ceased.

The woman slumped within the pillory, gasping like a fish stranded on land. Her tears and sweat had soaked through the filthy sack over her head, plastering it to the contours of her broken expression beneath. Each inhalation hitched with a sob, each exhalation dissolved into an uncontrollable whimper. It’s over… finally… over… The thought surfaced in her blank mind like a lifeline, bringing a wave of drained relief.

But then, a coarse, excited murmur rose from below the platform. It was a bucket of ice water dashed upon that fragile spark.

“My turn next!” a shrill voice crowed.

“Let’s see how long she lasts now!”

Heavy footfalls thudded on the planks once more—not receding, but approaching. More hands, bearing textures of varied cruelty—chipped and jagged nails, skin like coarse sandpaper—descended upon her skin, which still twitched with the ghost of the previous torment. Her underarms, the tender dip of her waist, even the vulnerable inner skin of her thighs… every recently violated area was now reclaimed as communal territory.

Her body flinched violently, as if seared. Not a full-throated struggle—that currency was spent. This was a neurological spasm, utterly beyond her control. The sobs twisted into a raw, animal keen forced from deep in her throat. She began to shake her head, the sack rasping a futile plea against the wood of the pillory, a sound she knew would meet no mercy.

So, the torment had not “stopped.” It had merely transitioned from a solo performance of cruelty to a communal sport. She was not a prisoner awaiting the end of a sentence, but a dish being passed around at a feast. This realization, colder and more penetrating than any scratching nail, froze the very core of her being.

The goblins jeered and laughed, placing bets on who could elicit the strongest tremors, debating which part of her was the most “entertaining” to exploit. Their language was a vulgar, degrading filth, each word stripping away another layer of her dignity. In this public, raucous defilement, her final, fragile fantasy—that it might end—was pulverized. And in that moment, she heard something within her crack with terrible clarity. It might have been her last shred of composure. Or perhaps, it was the final, dying echo of the idea that she was still a person, and not merely a thing.
A hand viciously yanked the sack from her head.

“Pah—! Cough! Hack!”

Chilly air, tainted with the salt of her own tears, spit, and sweat, flooded her mouth and nostrils, sending her into a fit of choking coughs. Her vision cleared abruptly—to reveal the squalid reality below. Countless pairs of goblin eyes, glinting with morbid curiosity, now reflected her image back at her.

The face once revered by the faithful for its divine serenity was now exposed in its most profane state. Her meticulously braided silver hair was a soaked, tangled mess plastered to her forehead and cheeks. Long lashes, clumped together by tears, failed to veil eyes that had once radiateed sacred light but now held only a hollow, shattered vacancy. A continuous stream of tears mingled with uncontrolled saliva, tracing paths down her jaw—which trembled with each ragged breath—before dripping onto the rough wood of the box beneath her, leaving dark, spreading stains.

Yet the most piercing sound was the manic laughter that continued to tear from her throat.

“Heh… haha… n-no… stop… HAHAHAHA!!”

It was a sharp, fragmented sound, having lost all rhythm of human speech. It resembled a physiological noise wrenched from the depths of her being by pure agony. Each paroxysm of laughter was punctuated by desperate, sobbing inhales and choked whimpers. She was weeping, yet her body convulsed in laughter; her will screamed for it to end, yet her nerves spasmed uncontrollably under the torment. This total schism between mind and flesh stripped away the last vestiges of her dignity as a person, reducing her to a primal, animalistic vessel of pure reaction.

The goblins watched, enthralled. To them, this was not cruelty, but a form of purification—a ritual to reduce the exalted sacred down to its base components: fragile flesh that wept, laughed, and broke just like their own. The more twisted her face became with anguish, the more despair saturated her laughter, the more successful the ritual proved to be.
When that face, slick with tears and sweat, was exposed to the light, a wave of commotion swept through the crowd below—a cacophony of whistles and raspy cheers.

“Look! Look at that hair!”

a goblin shrieked in broken common tongue, a grimy finger stabbing toward the platform. The papal silver hair, once a symbol of sanctity and wisdom that had flowed like molten silver under the ceremonial sun, now hung in damp, pathetic strands plastered to her flushed cheeks and neck. A few locks, caught in her violent thrashing, were even clenched between her own trembling lips. The ends trembled pitifully with each uncontrollable burst of laughter and convulsion.

“Sacred? Pope? Now she’s just a ticklish puppet who might wet herself! Haha!”

a cruder voice roared, triggering a wave of raucous laughter. The goblins strained their necks, their muddy eyes wide, greedily devouring every detail of her degradation—the face trying to turn away but jammed by the pillory, the lips bitten tight in humiliation and ticklish agony yet still leaking hysterical sounds, the slender wrists that once held the holy seal now raw and red from the ropes.

Her “pitiful” state, her “wretched” appearance, every single moment of her dignity unraveling burned through the conquerors’ nerves like the strongest liquor, delivering an unparalleled high. To destroy beauty, to defile sanctity, to drag a being from the clouds down into the muck to writhe with them—this was the ultimate sweetness the goblins could savor in their cruel game. Her distinctive silver hair no longer signified authority; instead, it became the perfect footnote identifying who she had been, thereby dramatically underscoring what she had become, bringing the theater of her fallen to its most poignant climax.
Ch. 5
As part of the goblin regime’s “orthodoxization,” countless nuns were systematically condemned as “heretics.” Stripped of their vestments, branded with humiliating sigils on their bodies, and assigned serial numbers, they were converted into public assets known as “Tickle-Slaves.”

The dungeon had been retrofitted. Less a traditional prison, it now functioned as a high-efficiency, utilitarian “sensory farm.” Thick stone pillars were studded with iron rings, each holding a figure secured in a meticulously calculated, leverage-less position. The air was damp and chill, carrying the smells of sweat, the salt of tears, and the faint, clinical scent of cheap antiseptic ointment.

There was no day or night, only perpetual “utilization.” Goblin soldiers came here to “unwind” after their shifts. Human collaborators—those eager to prove their loyalty or seeking a sense of belonging through shared cruelty—were even more frequent patrons. They were adept, well-versed in the minimal effort required to elicit the most prolonged reactions.

Thus, laughter became the omnipresent soundtrack. It was not joyous, but a sharp, shattered shrieking, interlaced with sobs and choking gasps. It erupted, echoed, and interlaced from every corner simultaneously, eventually coalescing into a boundless, mind-numbing ocean of sound. This ceaseless tidal wave of noise eternally washed against the stone, drowning out the last fading echoes of reason for all those trapped within its depths.
As part of the incentive structure, the "valiant" soldiers from the front lines were granted the first privilege to "enjoy" the spoils of war. These spoils were not gold or silver, but the registered, numbered "heretic" prisoners and "tickle-slaves."

Their "valor"—often quantified by strongholds captured or resistors slain—was directly convertible into "priority passes" for the dungeon. It was a meticulously calculated reward feedback loop: using the most direct sensory stimulation and thrill of domination to reinforce combat morale and deeply intertwine violent instinct with loyalty to the new regime.

Thus, the arrival of victory dispatches often coincided with another batch of "spoils" being delivered to the "experience zone." Soldiers would shed their blood-stained armor and, carrying the brutality that had not yet cooled from the battlefield, approach the bound figures. For them, this was more than relaxation; it was a ritual of extended dominance—conquering territory on the front lines, and conquering dignity here. The laughter, therefore, became the signature soundtrack to the celebration of victory.
The re-education quota knew no bounds. Whether it was a Cardinal in scarlet robes who once held the power of life and death over a diocese, a battle-hardened Templar Knight of unshakable faith, or even a dissident cleric who had miraculously evaded the Norse Unionen's dragnet only to be branded a "dangerous ideologue" by the new order—eventually, all their paths converged here.

There were no exceptions, and no one inquired about their past. All titles, feats of arms, and sectarian differences were systematically erased the moment they passed through the dungeon gate. They were uniformly logged as "high-value re-education assets," categorized by physiological tolerance and mental fortitude, and fed into the ceaselessly grinding re-forging machinery.

The goblins' "re-education" was a precise re-conditioning program. Its goal was not mere punishment, but complete formatting: using the most primal physical response (laughter) to overwrite past faith and glory, grinding down independent will into conditioned neural impulses. When knights‘ battle cry and cardinals’ prayer dissolved into the same rhythm of uncontrollable hysterics, the re-education was deemed "successful." The old world's hierarchy collapsed utterly here, as new, compliant subjects—responsive only to specific stimuli—were mass-produced amidst the laughter.
They had no names left, only sigils serial numbers branded onto their inner thighs, and a uniform designation: "Tickle-Slave - Public Asset." Only the head is still covered with some cloth, and its sole function to denote zoning. Designated sectors of the dungeon were marked as "Public Access Bays." Here, there were no "executioners," only "users."

An ordinary goblin grunt or laborer could trade a pittance of their pay or contribution points for a timed "usage permit." They entered bearing post-shift fatigue, boredom, or simple mischievous intent.

Here, torment was stripped of ritual, downgraded to a form of casual recreation.

Hands caked with mine dust or mud would casually grab a shackled ankle. The grit under unkempt nails scraped against the tender skin of a sole, provoking a grating, persistent tickling—not meticulously calculated, but all the more maddening for its crudeness. They might clumsily imitate half-remembered "techniques," skittering fingers along the soles, but more often it was a disorderly poking, digging, and prolonged scraping.

Coochie… Coochie…
The sound of nail on skin was audible in brief lulls, then swallowed by the inevitable eruption of laughter. This laughter was no longer the sharp, theatrical shattering of the high platform, but a weary, broken, hiccuping keen. Their abdominal muscles ached from constant spasms; tears had long been exhausted, leaving only dry, retching sounds hauled from deep in the throat. Their bodies betrayed them with incontinence, the floor a mingled map of waste and damp, the sharp tang of ammonia layering over the dungeon's base notes of mold and sweat.

The true cruelty lay in the arbitrariness and intermittency. One goblin might grow bored after minutes and wander off; another might take his place. No warning, no promise of an end. Fixed in place, they endured brief, terrifying respites, waiting for the next pair of hands whose arrival was never predictable. This waiting itself became a torture deeper than the tickling. Their consciousness, under this sustained sensory assault and hopeless anticipation, was gradually ground down into a hollow residue, responsive only to specific tactile stimuli. The litanies of old prayers fragmented into meaningless syllables in their minds, until finally, the very concept of "self" dissipated under the weight of this repeated, mundane dismemberment of the spirit.
The women laughed hysterically, tears streaming down like a burst dam. Their bodies writhed and slammed frantically against their restraints, trying to escape the unrelenting tickle torture from the soles of their feet, only to make the bindings feel more desperate. Hands that once wielded swords or delivered sermons could now only open and close in futile weakness. In the end, after a relentless “performance” administered by numerous hands in turn, their laughter grew hoarse and hollow, their gazes completely vacant, leaving only their bodies twitching and laughing mechanically.

Chapter 6:
The Papess and the Cardinal Nun, now branded as heretics, were marched to the abandoned livestock pen on the outskirts of the military encampment. Once used to contain beasts, this enclosure had now become a cage for the clergy. They were forcibly stripped of their remaining vestments, their naked forms exposed against rough-hewn posts—posts that had been conspicuously smoothed down, offering no purchase for the bound, yet retaining their primal, chilling texture.
The goblins cinched wide leather corset-straps around them, tightly lashing the women to the pillars. The leather bit into their waists, constricted their ribs, making every breath a labored, conscious act. This method of restraint carried a deliberate ritualistic quality: a treatment that was both like handling livestock awaiting slaughter and like presenting a blasphemous sacrifice. Their arms were pinned behind the posts, their necks immobilized. The only parts left free to move were their feet, deliberately left bare and dangling just above the dry straw.
This was the goblins' meticulously crafted ritual of humiliation: to expose bodies once venerated as sacred, stark naked in the wilderness, to the elements, to the gaze of passing soldiers and beasts. No whips—only this silent, sustained exhibition that peeled away layers of dignity. For them, reducing the holy to an object of ridicule offered a far greater satisfaction than mere slaughter.
What the goblins loved most, however, was their delicate, ticklish skin.
From time to time, passing goblins would gather around them, jeering freely while roughly groping their breasts or feet. Every touch sent tremors through their bodies, fear coursing through them like electric shocks.
Soon, the crude groping escalated into deliberate tickling. The women's uncontrollable laughter burst from the pen, echoing across the camp. They struggled, trembling—legs kicking, bodies writhing—but the leather restraints reduced their range of escape to a pathetic few inches. And tragically, whether it was their full breasts or bare soles, that delicate, well-cared-for skin now served as the perfect canvas for the goblins' torture, every inch exquisitely sensitive and responsive to their touch.
Tears and sweat trickled down their overheating skin. The women's helpless hysterics drew more goblins, gathering like predators scenting blood. Soon, every inch—full breasts, bare soles, trembling buttocks—became part of this collective game. Every patch of skin quivered, every laugh carried the weight of breaking minds.
"HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!! Don't—HAHAHAHA!!!"
Their anguished screams, tangled with helpless laughter, were all the entertainment the bored goblins could wish for—a carnival woven from dignity and torment.
No matter how they struggled, no matter how desperately they begged, the goblins remained utterly indifferent. They are treated as slaves, or even worse than livestock, merely as toys. They were nothing but playthings—fleshy toys that cried and laughed, designed for one purpose only. Every tremor, every plea, was coldly processed and transformed into a more vigorous assault. Pain, which should have been a warning, a boundary, here had only one destination: fuel for the sadists' widening grins.
A rough claw flicked the blindfold from the Papess's eyes. As the light stabbed in, those once-authoritative and merciful orbs now held only a tear-soaked vacancy. Lashes clung together in wet clumps, rims flushed red—yet her disheveled state was clearly not the goblins' focus. They roughly steadied her jaw, seeking a clearer view of the despair unraveling deep within her pupils. That was their favorite vista: the moment a soul crumbled completely, under their gaze.
They will become the newest batch of tickle-slaves sent to the Holy Goblin Kingdom—the moment the cold metal rings pierce their nipples, their former names, identities, and dignity will be sealed or erased forever. Ahead lay only one path: endless tickling, endless laughter, and the slow annihilation of self amidst the hysteria.

Chapter: 7
A new batch of high-value tickle-slaves is to be sent to the capital of the Holy Goblin Kingdom. Their bodies are tightly bound and crammed into wooden crates. The crates have been prepared with openings precisely positioned for their feet and breasts—those most sensitive, ticklish areas now cruelly exposed. This means that during the long journey, they will have no sense of safety whatsoever. At any moment, a guard may reach in, teasing and torturing them for amusement. Every moment of silence is merely a reprieve; every vibration could herald the onset of another uncontrollable fit of laughter.
The wooden crates were stacked layer upon layer on a rickety cart, their numbered sides pressing against one another like silent cargo.
The final batch of crates bearing "sinners" had been hoisted onto the wagon, pressed tightly against the rows already stacked in place. Between crate and crate, there was scarcely a gap—as if the naked bodies crammed within were already regarded as cargo undeserving of space or care.
A goblin overseer beside the beast-drawn cart waved his hand, signaling that loading was complete. One of the guards raised an oil lantern and swung it toward the front of the convoy—a signal flashed, and departure was imminent. Deep inside the crates, the women felt the wagon sink slightly under the added weight, and their hearts sank with it. None of them knew what torments awaited them at the end of this journey.
Massive beasts of burden, harnessed with coarse leather straps, let out low growls as they began to pull the prison cart laden with doomed fates. The axles screeched with every rotation, grinding over gravel and dust as the procession lurched slowly toward the capital. The women inside could not see one another, could not move, could not even anticipate whose hand might next reach through the openings. All they could do, in the darkness and the jolting, was wait for the tickling—whenever it might come—to drag them into another fit of helpless, uncontrollable laughter.

Chapter 8:

During the transport, when the convoy halted to rest overnight, the more popular tickle slaves—still inside their crates—were carried into a small room at the edge of the encampment. The crates were lined up side by side. At one end of each crate, a round hole allowed the women’s bare feet to protrude, their helpless soles trembling in the air. On top, a larger opening exposed their breasts completely. The rest of their bodies were firmly fixed within the wooden walls, leaving them unable to curl away or even twist.
Five goblins surrounded the crates. They did not reach for the exposed breasts, but instead began with the most devastating spot—the soles of the feet. Rough fingertips, jagged nails, traced precisely along the arches, taut with fear. The ticklish sensation shot up their spines like lightning, shattering the women’s will in an instant. Uncontrollable laughter burst from their throats—laughter devoid of any joy, filled only with despair and helplessness. These once highborn women, who had issued commands, conducted holy rites, and led armies, were now reduced to the basest playthings. Under the fingers of five goblins, they arched their backs, twisted their bodies, and spewed out forced, hysterical laughter. Laughter—helpless and resounding—is echoing through the small room.
The five women's ticklish feet, the moment rough fingertips touched their soles, convulsed wildly, curling and kicking as if jolted by electricity. Their toes clenched together, then spread apart helplessly, trying to escape the maddening itch. But rubber like cuffs firmly locked their ankles in place, pinning every struggle to the spot. The harder they struggled, the shriller and louder the laughter and screams forced from their throats—and that was the very melody the goblins loved most. The more the women suffered, the more gleefully the goblins grinned. In the eyes of those green-skinned fiends, the fiercer these five fought and the louder they cried out, the more they proved themselves to be "qualified tickle-slaves." Each burst of uncontrollable laughter reaffirmed their new identity: they were no longer noble nuns or a papess, but merely qualified toys that laughed, wept, and writhed.
Seeing that the warm up was complete, more goblins joined in—now that the women’s breasts were also exposed. Those who had been focusing only on the soles turned their attention to the openings on top of the crates. Rough fingers pinched the nipples, or nails lightly traced the edges of the areolas. The new stimulation made the women’s laughter even shriller. Their bodies writhed helplessly inside the crates, but there was no escape. The small room filled with a blend of laughter and low guttural noises that lasted well into the night.
The five tickle-slaves imprisoned in this small room had been destined to serve simultaneously as “breast-slaves” and “foot-slaves.” Their plump, rounded breasts—once hidden beneath holy vestments, once gazed upon by worshippers—were now nothing more than playthings for goblins to knead, pinch, and scratch at will. Their delicate, well-tended soles, so sensitive to the touch, would endure the relentless teasing of rough fingertips and feathers day after day. No dignity, no moment of respite. Every inch of their sensitive bodies had been carefully tagged, categorized, and marked for endless exploitation. To the goblins, these five bodies were simply five brand new sets of toys, each one equipped with the finest pair of breasts and feet.

Chapter 9:
In what was once the capital of the Imareich, the city of Vindodunum now belonged entirely to the goblins. Green banners bearing a golden axe hung from walls and eaves, fluttering in the wind as a constant reminder of the old order’s utter collapse.
Today, the city would host a grand victory parade. The women who had been imprisoned for days inside narrow wooden crates were finally dragged out. Their hands were bound tightly behind their backs with coarse ropes, the fibers digging deep into their skin, leaving livid red marks. They were stripped bare except for two things: a pair of high heels designed specifically for tickle-slaves, their soles embedded with living, controllable tendrils that could torment their sensitive feet at any moment, and the headpieces that once symbolized their former status—now a mockery of their past.
Naked, they were pushed into the long procession. Barbaric goblin conquerors lined the cobblestone avenue, eager to witness with their own eyes the symbols of power that had once seemed so untouchable, now stripped of every shred of dignity, walking naked toward a new existence. The living high heels beneath their feet were both a tool and a prison: the tendrils clung to their delicate soles, not only preventing the tender skin from being worn down on the rough stones (thus preserving them for future ticklish torments), but also ready at any moment to writhe or scratch, sending uncontrollable tremors and hysterical laughter through their bodies. Every step was a battle against loss of control; every twitch of a tendril could cause them to lose composure in full public view—reduced, then and there, to the jest of the goblins’ celebration.
A goblin junior officer tugged a long rope, to which a string of naked women were tethered, stumbling along Vindodunum's cobblestone avenue. At the head of the line walked the former Papess, once the most revered figure in the Holy See. Upon her head rested the high tiara she had seldom worn even in her days of power—a jeweled crown symbolizing supreme spiritual authority. Now it sat heavily upon her disheveled silver hair, a grotesque mockery of its former meaning. Beneath the crown, her body was completely bare, her pale skin exposed to the sun and the leering gazes of the crowd. Most searing of all was the brand burnt into her pubis—the word "HERETIC" in harsh, scarred letters, rimmed with dark, crusted edges, like an unhealable curse. She kept her head lowered, her steps unsteady, yet she was forced to follow the pull of the rope. Behind her, the other four women, equally naked, stumbled forward trembling, step by step, toward their new existence, all while the goblins lining both sides roared with laughter.
Just as Urbana III lowered her head, trying to maintain the last shred of dignity amidst the goblins' jeering laughter, the living high heels beneath her feet began to writhe. The soft tendrils clinging to her soles, like serpents awakened from slumber, suddenly pressed tightly against her sensitive arches, then began to scrape rhythmically and delicately—every inch of her soles covered with precise, tormenting strokes.
In that instant, the Papess's body went rigid as if struck by lightning. She opened her mouth, trying to stifle the sound about to tear from her throat—but the tendrils chose that very moment to flick against her soles. "Pffhahahaha—!!" A sharp, crystalline burst of laughter exploded from deep within her, without warning. Her knees buckled instantly; she staggered, and had it not been for the rope, she would have fallen. Yet the tendrils did not stop—they only grew more relentless, writhing, scraping, pricking, as if countless tiny fingertips were dancing across her soles. Her laughter became uncontrollable, bursting forth in wild, high-pitched peals. Tears streamed from her eyes, mingling with saliva spilled from her ragged breaths, dripping down her chin.
The women behind her were soon subjected to the same assault—shrill giggles, screams, and pleas rose and fell in a chaotic chorus that echoed throughout the cobblestone avenue. The goblins lining the sides beat their weapons in excitement, roaring with hoarse cheers and mockery, as if this were a feast prepared solely for their delight. Through her laughter, the Papess managed to lift her head, and through tear-blurred eyes, she saw the endless road ahead—and she knew: this was only the beginning. The tendrils beneath her feet continued to writhe, gentle yet cruel, again and again, pushing her deeper into the abyss of utter loss of control.
The tendrils beneath their soles stopped abruptly. Before they could draw a breath of relief, new tendrils slid between their toes. Slender tips pushed into the narrow gaps, pressing against thin, sensitive skin that had never been so directly touched. The tendrils scraped back and forth within those tight spaces, each pass tracing the delicate creases at the base of their toes, then forced deeper, reaching into every hidden fold. They began to twist, rotating against the tender edges of the toes, grinding the nerve endings repeatedly. The itch was far more intense than that on the soles—it shot up to the back of their skulls like electric jolts, making their knees weak and their scalps tingle.
The tendrils beneath their soles stopped abruptly, but they had no time to catch their breath. The residual friction between their toes lingered, reverberating through their nerve endings, slowing their steps with every stride. Each lift of the foot felt like treading on cotton; their knees trembled faintly, calf muscles twitching with the ghost of spasms. That itch, compared to a full tickle torture, was little more than a game—yet it clung like a thin mist to the surface of their skin, seeping steadily into the crevices of their nerves. The laughter was not violent—just low, breathy giggles that leaked from their throats in fits and starts, muffled as if something soft were blocking their windpipes. It lacked explosive force, but carried a sticky, insidious quality that excited the goblins, spreading slowly along the cobblestone road.
These tendrils followed no fixed pattern. Sometimes they concentrated on the soles, rubbing back and forth in an unrelenting rhythm that bred a steady, simmering itch; sometimes they suddenly darted to the heels, their pointed tips jabbing at the tough, sensitive edges there, sending jolts of spasm from the base of her spine. More often, they took turns coiling around her toes, slipping in and out of the gaps like nimble tongues, each pass bringing a sensation as sharp as salt rubbed into a fresh wound—yet laced with an unnerving, lingering warmth that unsettled her even more. The most tormenting part was their rhythm: at times, all five tendrils attacked in unison, scraping different points simultaneously and drowning her in an overwhelming tide of itch; at others, they withdrew completely, leaving behind an aching emptiness that kept her taut nerves suspended in silence, waiting for the next ambush. Her body no longer belonged to her—each ripple of movement ignited fresh flames at the ends of her nerves, and her reason crumbled, slowly, like a sandcastle eroded by relentless tides.
The goblins lining the roadside watched with rapt attention, their coarse laughter rising and falling in waves. Some raised their hands and cheered; others clapped and jeered; still others pointed with rough fingers, as if judging who would break first. "What a lovely laugh!" Their amusement was utterly unrestrained—they treated it like a free carnival performance, each hysterical shriek only fueling their excitement further. The applause and catcalls swirled into a searing tide, pushing the Papess and the women behind her ever closer to the precipice of their last shred of dignity. And in their ears, it seemed to echo—a continuous, fragmented whisper: "This is just a parade… This is only the beginning…"
Their skin began to redden all over, spreading from their chests to their necks, as if heat were being forced out from within, burning at the surface. Their toes curled helplessly, trying to trap the intruders—yet that only made the tendrils press deeper, rub more insistently, driving the torment to a new peak.
The goblin officer yanked the rope roughly, dragging the women forward across the cobblestones as if they were livestock. They stumbled barefoot, their knees scraping against the rough stone, but no one was allowed to stop. The rope bit deep into the skin of their wrists, every tug a grim reminder: they were no longer "they"—only merchandise that walked, screamed, and broke into helpless laughter.
Every parade of shame, every conquest, delivered new tickle-slaves to the Holy Goblin Kingdom—and with each delivery, the realm built on green flesh and iron grew ever more prosperous. And those humans who chose to bend the knee before fear and gain would, in time, shed their old loyalties, don the goblins' emblems, and become their accomplices—trading their own kind for a moment's safety, trampling dignity to secure a place among the victors.
Chapter10 :
The women’s bare feet were strapped to wooden frames, thick leather bands wound tightly around their ankles, locking the slender joints in place. They sat upon the platform, soles turned outward, insteps stretched taut, toes slightly spread—exposing to the thousands of eyes below that which had once been hidden beneath long robes and sacred footwear. Goblins and humans stood side by side at the foot of the dais, gazing up, their rough murmurs and stifled chuckles weaving together like merchants appraising livestock at market.
Then, heavy footsteps sounded from the side of the platform. A goblin in a black robe ascended slowly, bearing a black metal tray in both hands. At the center of the tray rested an open crystal bottle, its surface gleaming with a dull, dark luster. Within it lay a thick black liquid—deep as night, absorbing all light—the specially formulated, never-fading nail polish reserved for tickle-slaves. The goblin set the tray down with deliberate care at the center of the platform, then bowed slightly, as if performing an ancient rite of offering. The lid had not yet been removed; no brush had been dipped; no pale toe had yet been touched. But the black already lay there upon the dais, silent and waiting—like a verdict awaiting execution.
The executioner bent down, gently holding one woman’s toe with one hand, while with the other he took up the slender brush, dipped it into the thick black liquid, and began to paint from the base of the nail, stroke by even stroke. He moved with surprising slowness, as if tracing some sacred script, never missing the smallest curve along the nail’s edge. After each nail was finished, he would pause, inspect it carefully to ensure the coating was even, and then proceed to the next. The square fell silent; only the faint rustle of the brush against the nails could be heard, like the distant hum of insects. Layer by layer, the black built up, gradually swallowing the pale surfaces beneath—a slow, irreversible encroachment, claiming each toe, one after another, into the goblins’ mark.
All the nails were painted—row after row of feet, nail after nail, gleaming in uniform black beneath the afternoon sun. The executioner straightened up and let out a long breath, like a craftsman who had just completed an immensely painstaking task. He tilted his head slightly, sweeping his gaze across the orderly rows of toes, confirming that every nail had been evenly coated, with no oversight. Then he gave a slight nod, returned the brush to the tray, and stepped back, as though a long sacrificial rite had finally come to an end. Yet the black was already seared into countless eyes—an irreversible proclamation: these toes no longer belonged to their owners.
The goblins below erupted into thunderous cheers. Hoarse shouts mixed with the rhythmic clatter of weapons striking the ground, echoing across the square. To them, this was not a punishment—it was a rite: another chance to witness the Kingdom’s triumph, to reaffirm the conqueror’s supremacy. The black-painted nails glistened in the sunlight, like flags planted in their prey.

On the platform, the tickling officially began. The goblins formed a line, mounting the wooden steps one after another—like gluttons awaiting their share of a sacrificial feast. Grins spread across their faces; their rough hands flexed in the air, cracking knuckles as if warming up for a game. The several rows of bare, strapped feet on the platform had become the main attraction of this interlude.
A squat, stocky goblin crouched before the first woman—the former Papess. He extended two fingers and traced them lightly across her sole, as if testing the terrain. Urbana III’s body tensed instantly; her lips pressed tightly together, trying to suppress the laughter already welling up in her throat. But his fingers did not linger. They moved to her heel, pressing the pad of his thumb against the slightly rougher edge there, then began to rub in slow circles. At that moment, a stifled laugh burst from deep in her throat; her knees trembled, but she could not pull away from the wooden frame.

The goblin looked up, baring yellowed teeth. “Oh? If it isn’t Her Holiness. How come you’re so ticklish?” His tone was teasing, almost familiar, like an old friend’s—but his fingers never stopped. They quickened, alternating between scraping her arch and her sole. Urbana’s laughter began to spiral out of control; her body arched backward involuntarily, her waist lifting slightly off the frame. “Ahaha—stop… st—op…!” She managed to force out a few words, but they came in broken fragments.

At the same time, the Cardinal Nun beside her was enduring a similar assault. A lanky goblin had parted her toes one by one, rubbing his fingertips in the spaces between them with relentless precision. The skin there was thin, almost never exposed to such direct stimulation. From the very start, she arched her back as if jolted by electricity, letting out a thin, rapid-fire giggle that trembled like a plucked string. “Eeehahahaha—! No, not there!” Her eyes reddened; she shook her head desperately, but she could not stop his fingers from delving deeper into the tender gaps between her toes, scraping back and forth with meticulous care.

Farther down the line, the former Knight-Commander of the Holy Order was left with nothing but her feet twitching weakly. Her knees had been clenched at first, as if she were still trying to hold on to the last shred of willpower. But when the goblin’s palm flattened against her entire sole, and all five fingers began to claw and knead at once—her body gave way like a puppet with cut strings. A low, hoarse laugh welled up from her chest, laced with sobs. “Agh—ha—no, no… not the soles…” She tried to fight it, but failed; she laughed until she could barely breathe.
The platform was filled with overlapping bursts of laughter—some shrill, some raspy, some punctuated by brief whimpers or pleas—but none of it could halt the unceasing motion of those fingers. The goblins exchanged glances, sometimes murmuring to one another, as if judging whose reaction was the most entertaining. “This one’s soles are the softest…” “Look at that one—her toes curl up on their own!” Their laughter was coarse and light, as though they were truly just enjoying a casual show.

But for the women on that platform, it was a ritual of complete identity dissolution. The fingers that had once taught others how to resist temptation and hold fast to belief could now only curl and tremble helplessly. The voices that had once commanded battle lines and denounced heresy were reduced to broken laughter and slurred pleas. Most of their eyes were moist; some wept, some shut their eyes, others stared blankly upward. But their faces all bore the same flush of heat—cheek muscles aching from sustained contractions, vocal cords growing hoarse from relentless vibration.

The platform remained shrouded in laughter. Under the sunlight, the goblins stood in line, patiently awaiting their turns. For them, the show was far from over.
